story_targets.narrative_hook: The greatest World Cup final ever decided from the spot: Messi vs Mbappe, Martinez vs destiny

events.description: Mbappe scores France's first penalty of the shootout. France leads the shootout 1-0. The hat-trick hero steps up first and delivers under pressure
Messi scores Argentina's first penalty. The captain equalises in the shootout 1-1. Messi calmly slots it past Lloris to keep Argentina level
Martinez saves Coman's penalty. The Aston Villa keeper dives to his left to deny Coman. France still 1-1 in the shootout. Martinez's gamesmanship with the referee builds tension
Dybala scores Argentina's second penalty. Argentina leads the shootout 2-1. Dybala's composed finish puts Argentina ahead for the first time in the shootout
Martinez saves Kolo Muani's penalty. Another brilliant save from Martinez, diving to his right. Argentina 2-1 in the shootout. France on the brink of defeat

Montiel scores the winning penalty for Argentina. Argentina win the World Cup 4-2 on penalties. Montiel slots it past Lloris and the nation erupts. Argentina are world champions for the first time since 1986
